resources.string: Official Lucide icons for Android launchers
Open Lawnchair settings → Icon style / Icon pack → choose Lucidy Icons. Other launchers: look for “Icon pack” or “Theme” and select Lucidy Icons.
Icons are converted path-for-path from the official Lucide set (MIT). Lucide is made by the Lucide contributors — https://lucide.dev. Lucidy only packages them for launcher theming.
